intro: A retail sales associate resume that shows sales results, customer service and the extra responsibilities you took on.
tips: Show sales numbers: targets beaten, add-on sales, rankings.
Give examples of service: reviews, regular customers.
Mention extra duties: opening, closing, cash, visual displays.

basics.name: Emily Nguyen
basics.label: Retail Sales Associate
basics.summary: Retail sales associate with three years in fashion and electronics. I like helping people find the right thing, and I beat my targets doing it.

work.name: NorthPeak Outfitters
highlights: Beat my monthly sales target in 20 of the last 24 months.
Top seller of the store's loyalty programme, with 300 sign-ups.
Trusted to open and close, run the till and count the safe.

highlights: Advised customers on laptops and phones; 40% of my sales included a protection plan.
Set up product displays for two big launches.
